integrity: Exact identities and Sturm root counts verified from an embedded standalone reproducibility script; independent review or validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Ideal equal-volume, three-site nearest-neighbor exchange; one common rate; fixed nocturnal interval; no losses; instantaneous, not integrated, uptake potential; parameters not field calibrated. The claim is an exact mathematical two-vs-three critical-point classification and a rational example, not a claim about field transpiration.
title: Three soil regions are minimal for two uptake peaks under nocturnal hydraulic redistribution
